> **GPU text and stencil fixes** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 corrects GPU text teardown and stencil-clear handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU stencil and text stability** — Corrects clipped render-pass stencil-clear checks and native destruction order when corrupt GPU text data is rejected. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429), [#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))
